title: Closeout requested (Segment C trigger)
description: The message Pega sends to start Amendia Segment C (ach-closeout) after FIS has released or purged the transaction. Author this schema in the onboarding wizard. The pack's triage rule matches on request_type == "CloseoutRequested"; case_id is the cohort correlation key. instruction is the disposition FIS applied. Field shapes match the mock Pega orchestrator's segment_c_payload.

case_id.description: Pega case id — the cohort correlation_value.
